name: Spotify Premium Student
summary: Discounted Spotify Premium for enrolled students.
key: $7.99 a month after a free first month, for up to 4 years.
who: Over 18 and enrolled at an eligible accredited institution.
how: Sign up on Spotify's student page and verify through SheerID.
catches: After 4 years it moves to Premium Individual at $15.99 a month.
